away.name: Samuel Ersson
away.news: Linus Ullmark (lower body) is nearing a return, but the Senators will continue rolling with Ersson on Wednesday. The 27-year-old Ersson has struggled with the Senators, but is coming off his best performance of the season, saving 22 of 23 shots (.957 SV%) in a 5-1 win over the San Jose Sharks. He has a 3.78 GAA and .866 SV% in seven appearances this season (1-3-1). The Senators enter Wednesday's game as +113 road underdogs against a Buffalo Sabres team with points in four straight games (3-0-1).

home.name: Colten Ellis
home.news: Ellis has started two of the past three games for the Sabres and will return to the crease on Wednesday. The 26-year-old Ellis has been inconsistent, but has won more often than not. In his most recent game, he allowed six goals on 35 shots (.829 SV%), but managed to hold on for a 7-6 win over the Anaheim Ducks. He has a 3.11 GAA and .880 SV% in five games this season (3-1-1). The Sabres enter Wednesday's action as -126 home favourites against an Ottawa Senators team that has lost three of their last four games (1-2-1).

away.name: Spencer Knight
away.news: After a promising inaugural full season with the Blackhawks in 2025-26, posting a 2.82 GAA and .902 SV% in 55 games (19-25-11), Knight has had an inconsistent start to 2026-27. In his most recent game, he allowed four goals on 28 shots (.857 SV%) in a 5-2 loss to the Colorado Avalanche, ending a four-game streak in which he allowed three or fewer goals (1-3-0). The 25-year-old American goalie has a 3.28 GAA and .894 SV% in 12 games this season (4-8-0). The Blackhawks enter Wednesday's game as sizeable +223 road underdogs against a Florida Panthers team that is 3-1-0 in their last four games.

home.name: Jacob Markstrom
home.news: In Florida's previous game, Markstrom returned from a two-week absence due to an upper-body injury and struggled to regain his form, allowing four goals on 28 shots (.857 SV%) in a 5-3 loss to the Detroit Red Wings. The 36-year-old Swedish goalie has had an up-and-down start to the 2026-27 season, posting a 2.50 GAA and .890 SV% in seven appearances (3-2-1). That said, the Panthers enter Wednesday's game as significant -260 home favourites against a Chicago Blackhawks team they defeated 3-2 less than two weeks ago.

away.name: Yaroslav Askarov
away.news: While the Sharks have struggled, going 1-4-0 in their last five, Askarov has showcased some of his best netminding with the team. The 24-year-old Russian goalie saved 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in his most recent game, a 2-1 loss to the Calgary Flames. He has saved 152 of 161 shots (.944 SV%) in his last five outings (2-3-0). The Sharks enter Wednesday's game as +147 road underdogs against a Los Angeles Kings team coming off a 3-2 loss to the Buffalo Sabres.

away.name: Dustin Wolf
away.news: With Devin Cooley (lower body) still sidelined, the Flames will continue to lean on Wolf. Wolf had an impressive rookie season in 2024-25, finishing runner-up for the Calder Trophy, but has struggled since. That said, he has strung together some better outings lately, posting a 3.00 GAA and .892 SV% in his last five games. The Flames enter Wednesday's game as +116 road underdogs against a Seattle Kraken team that hasn't played since losing 6-2 to the Flames on October 30th.
